title: Attention Is All You Need
method: Transformer architecture based on attention mechanisms, replacing recurrent and convolutional networks
key_contributions: The Transformer is a new architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, without recurrence or convolutions.
Experiments show the model is superior in quality, more parallelizable, and requires less training time.
The model achieves 28.4 BLEU on English-to-German and 41.0 BLEU on English-to-French tasks, surpassing prior results.
final_summary: The paper introduces the Transformer, a new architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, replacing recurrent/convolutional networks. It demonstrates superior performance in machine translation tasks with faster training and better BLEU scores.
